title: Tiberius Aerospace, a defense-as-a-service startup that uses AI to design long-range supersonic artillery munitions, raised an $85M Series A at a $1B+ valuation (Isabella Ward/Wired)
summary: Isabella Ward / Wired: Tiberius Aerospace, a defense-as-a-service startup that uses AI to design long-range supersonic artillery munitions, raised an $85M Series A at a $1B+ valuation — Google and Apple alumni Chad Steelberg and Andy Baynes are applying what they learned running software companies and designing iPhones to manufacturing lethal munitions.
